details.proposed_subject: Hartford gate kiosk incident timeline, 3 Aug 2026
details.proposed_body:
Odile,

Timeline from the #inc-vtg-hartford incident room, Vantorre Group Hartford plant, 3 Aug 2026 (times as posted in the channel):

- 10:42 AM: First report. Gate kiosks offline at the Hartford plant; both inbound lanes showing a white screen after badge scan.
- 11:03 AM: Kiosk 1 back in service; guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch saw it.
- 11:07 AM: Both inbound lanes working (reported 11:08 AM).

Kiosk 2 was asked to stay powered on for reconnect attempts; reconnect log sent to you separately. Status-page access for the customer is a separate open issue, tracked on INC-4821.

Gideon Sato
